verdict.rationale: Cloudflare ships Wrangler as its official command-line tool for Workers. The docs say its core commands cover "creating, developing, and deploying Workers", and rollbacks to earlier versions can be done with Wrangler instead of the dashboard. Projects are scaffolded from the terminal with `npm create cloudflare@latest`. Missing for 10: an explicit deploy command example (e.g. the actual deploy invocation and its options), independent or hands-on corroboration of a CLI-only deploy.
